title: Patch: callout icons for the ten tempo keywords
notes: R2791000: the ten tempo keywords (Charge, Rush, Equip, Tradable, Stack, Spell Damage, Lucky, Deft, Flashback, Temporary) each get a callout icon for their effect beat. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.
